duration: Youth of the Year sessions start in January
pay_detail: Teen membership is free. Winners of Youth of the Year are eligible for Club scholarships.
name: Keystone Club and Youth of the Year
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of North Central Illinois
city: Elgin, South Elgin, Aurora, Streamwood, Hanover Park and Schaumburg, IL
what_you_do: Keystone Club builds leadership through school help, career prep and community service. Youth of the Year trains teens in public speaking, resume writing and social justice. Then it holds a contest. Winners can get Club scholarships.
who_can_apply: Keystone Club is for ages 14 to 18. Youth of the Year is for ages 10 to 18. You must be a Club member. Teen membership (middle and high school) is free, and you must meet the local residency or school district rules.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Youth of the Year sessions start each January. Applications are processed in the order received.
how_to_apply: Create an account in MyClubHub, pick your clubhouse and fill out the membership application. Staff will email next steps and a start date. Contact for Youth of the Year: cmaxwell@bgcelgin.org.
notes: Age limits can differ by clubhouse. The Industry Clubs (paid career programs for teens) are a separate listing. A Schaumburg Teen Center page exists but only shows a calendar.
